notes: Every answer is derivable only from agent/corpus and agent/tools/mock_api.py, so no backend can score by recall alone. Temperature is 0 for every run; seed is sent to backends that accept it and ignored by those that do not. Answers are compared after normalising case, commas, currency words and whitespace.
